rows.title: Deep learning–based visual diagnosis of Huanglongbing and zinc deficiency in citrus leaves for sustainable and precision orchard management
rows.verification_source: Undermind exact metadata lookup + full abstract
rows.focus: Citrus greening or Huanglongbing (HLB) is a major threat to global citrus production, yet its visual symptoms often overlap with those of zinc (Zn) deficiency, complicating accurate diagnosis and disease management. This study presents a biologically validated, image-based deep learning method for distinguishing HLB, Zn deficiency, and their co-occurrence in citrus leaves. A total of 2,500 leaves were collected from commercial orchards and imaged using high-resolution flatbed scanning. Five independent expert observers visually classified each leaf into four categories: healthy, HLB, Zn deficiency, and combined HLB and Zn. All samples were subjected to PCR analysis to confirm HLB infection.
